en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father, my brother, and the group narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, and from others, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali Al-Būfaki, from someone whose name he mentioned, who said: The son of Riďā (Imam Jawād (a.s.)) said:
Those who go to the Ziyārah of my aunt in Qum will be rewarded with Paradise.
